Record shows ⇧R where Figma shows R. New finding: the gallery fixture's engine hotkeys (MockServices.swift:150-185: stop 's', prev 'p', next 'n', record 'Shift+r', fullscreen 'f', mute 'm', snapshot 'Shift+s') are VLC's NON-Apple defaults. On macOS, VLC's compiled defaults (src/libvlc-module.c, the __APPLE__ block from line 2284) are Stop ⌘., Previous ⌘←, Next ⌘→, Record ⇧⌘R, Fullscreen ⌘F.
